{{Short description|Concept in algebraic geometry}}
In [[algebraic geometry]], a '''Kuga fiber variety''', introduced by {{harvs|txt|last=Kuga|authorlink=Michio Kuga|year=1966}}, is a [[Fiber bundle|fiber space]] whose fibers are [[abelian variety|abelian varieties]] and whose base space is an [[Arithmetic variety|arithmetic quotient]] of a [[Hermitian symmetric space]].
